title: Impairment of Assets
summary: Prescribes the procedures for identifying and measuring impairment of assets, including recoverable amount, cash-generating units and goodwill impairment testing, converged almost exactly with IAS 36.

bannerNotice.title: Ind AS – Closely Converged with IAS 36
bannerNotice.body: Ind AS 36 reproduces IAS 36's recoverable amount, cash-generating unit (CGU), and goodwill impairment testing framework almost exactly, with no substantive divergence. Its Indian practical relevance is prominent for the discount rate benchmarks used in value-in-use calculations and for CGU determination in large, diversified Indian conglomerate structures. Section 11 covers the full comparison.
